Hand-trimmed subset of the vendored official protos (same package, messages, field numbers) so the test harness can serve ext_authz gRPC without Envoy's full import closure. envoy.fixtures.test.ts re-derives every field number from the official files.

Captured from a running Envoy (6eb0d2d97489ec1b4e1584a004f5de443d97a41b/1.39.3/Clean/RELEASE/BoringSSL, tetratelabs archive-envoy darwin-arm64, same version as the vendored protos) by src/envoy.integration.test.ts with PCA_ENVOY_CAPTURE: HTTP ext_authz http_service requests received by the check service. The PCA-Action value is a placeholder and large bodies are elided. sourceSha256 is the sha256 of the Envoy tarball.
